children: Madan brings more than 20 years of experience across marketing, digital and consumer experience, after an eight-year stint with the company
Anjali Madan has taken on the role of Consumer Experience Lead, Southeast Asia at Mondelēz International.
Madan has been associated with Mondelēz International for more than eight years and brings over 20 years of experience across marketing, digital and consumer experience.

Before joining Mondelēz International, Madan was with Mindshare, where she worked across roles including Mindshare Fulcrum. She has also held positions at Madison Media (Pinnacle), Virgin Mobile India and TVS Motor Company.
Her new mandate at Mondelēz International will see her lead consumer experience across the Southeast Asia market.
